notes: Standalone spoken letter names; no key suffix and no NATO phonetic substitutions.
Uppercase and lowercase resolve to the same letter sound.
Z is zed for declared en-gb roles and zee for en-us roles.
All existing character presets and headset channels are preserved.

line_up_wait.condition: runway entry authorized and landing/takeoff conflict checks satisfied

takeoff_clearance.condition: takeoff authorization granted for this runway and aircraft; runway clear

landing_clearance.condition: landing authorization granted for this runway and aircraft; runway separation satisfied

left_downwind.condition: left circuit assigned and safe route

right_downwind.condition: right circuit assigned and safe route

straight_in.condition: straight-in approach assigned and terrain/traffic route valid

wind_gusting.condition: actual gust exceeds actual sustained wind

departure_frequency.condition: active departure frequency modeled and handoff authorized

taxi.condition: actual cleared taxi route provided; runway crossings require separate authorizations

integration.station_voice_policy: Assign one tower voice to an airport and keep it for the whole exchange; do not reroll each utterance.
integration.guidance_policy: Play clearance/instruction only after the corresponding modeled ATC state decision; never choose procedural instructions as random ambient chatter.
integration.priority: Go-around/emergency > runway conflict > clearance > sequencing/weather > greeting
integration.squelch: Fragments have no per-piece squelch. Add one boundary cue to a complete radio transmission.
integration.claims: Assets and resolver only; no game branch changes or implemented ATC decision engine.
